oracle_policy: Each watch assertion has a nonzero fixed expected pointer and explicit planner/source mapping; source facts are pinned independently and planner-only watch semantics are not falsely attributed to prior oracles. Candidate output never creates or amends expectations.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Check no fabricated watch before confirmation and keep saved configuration separate from an unknown cold-graph result.
cases.setup: Query before local confirmation, then read saved configuration against a newly owned empty graph.
cases.failure_detected: Fabricated watch/data or unknown promoted to unchanged, no-owner, or safe.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Preview then explicitly confirm one local watch while checking graph and action-file side effects.
cases.setup: Preview R1 at 20:29Z × 20:17:59Z; inspect state; confirm once and inspect local/graph/external writes.
cases.failure_detected: Preview writes state, the separate store boundary is violated, graph/actions change, or external effects occur.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Hold valid time at 20:29Z and advance only source knowledge past R2 observation.
cases.setup: Compare baseline at 20:29Z × 20:17:59Z with current result at 20:29Z × 20:19Z.
cases.failure_detected: R2 missing, applied early, or promoted from pending review; selected role incorrectly changes.

source_mappings.source_assertion_text: queue is exactly HND-DOCK-2020 and TKT-DOCK-88

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Cross valid/knowledge boundaries without hindsight or early effective ownership.
cases.setup: Compare 20:30Z × 20:17:59Z with 20:30Z × 20:19Z relative to saved R1.
cases.failure_detected: R2 leaks early, unknown is guessed, or known future-effective R2 is described as already effective at known_at.

source_mappings.source_assertion_text: 20:30Z is the exact ROLE-DOCK-SWING five-node path

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Compare the ordered saved path/source pair with each live bitemporal result and missing support.
cases.setup: Exercise all four fixed pairs against the same saved R1 baseline; remove test-owned required evidence in an isolated graph.
cases.failure_detected: Status promotion, missing-source resolution, risk score, contact, or completeness is inferred.

source_mappings.source_assertion_text: R1 and R2 identifiers/titles/observed timestamps remain visible

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove each test-owned R2 dependency independently and reseed exact evidence.
cases.setup: On the owned graph remove only SUPERSEDES, only R2 OWNED_BY, and only R2 source evidence; compare unaffected output.
cases.failure_detected: Static/lexical fallback survives removal, unrelated result changes, or R2 metadata/future role remains without evidence.

source_mappings.source_assertion_text: removing an owned dependency changes only its corresponding recorded path

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject the accepted restricted fixture and compare complete operations-visible watch results.
cases.setup: At all four axis pairs, compare API, stored-visible status, counts/errors and accessible desktop/mobile DOM before/after using source-pinned tripwires.
cases.failure_detected: Direct/derived hidden source disclosure or any semantically visible response delta occurs.

source_mappings.source_assertion_text: no path or inferred/paraphrased fact through denied evidence leaks
no conveyor restricted event/source ID, title, fact, or restricted-source-dependent time/value leaks

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Normalize offset timestamps; reject malformed and duplicate time-axis inputs before mutation; keep refresh read-only.
cases.setup: Probe canonical/+02:00 pairs, malformed effective_at/known_at and duplicated query parameters for each axis; snapshot graph/local state.
cases.failure_detected: Time axes diverge, duplicate axis is accepted, invalid input mutates state or refresh writes data.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Repeat confirmation with one explicit token, reconnect, recompute live query and clean only owned resources.
cases.setup: Cold start, seed twice, confirm twice with same token, reconnect fresh client after restart, compare API/browser and remove only this run’s graph/process/watch state.
cases.failure_detected: Duplicate watch, lost baseline, stale cached result, cross-lane cleanup or external write.
